reviews.comment: Great professor, at start of semester it was hard to hear him, but eventually it became easier. Gave good homework, tests followed format of homeworks. Overall great guy
reviews.ratingTags: Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: tests were like the homework he gave. gives a cheat sheet for the tests. practice exams were like the test and he gives as much credit as he can on the tests. he was very helpful when you asked questions after class. curved the class at the end.
reviews.ratingTags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: He's a young grad student/freshly out & speaks very softly, if you sit in the back row you won't be able to hear anything. u'll end up teaching urself most of the stuff from the book, some methods which he chooses to suit to his own teaching style and u'll lose points for doing it like the book. + No TAs. HW was helpful for exams, notes illegible.

Dr. Hu's homeworks were relatively easy, but his exams were difficult. It was sometimes difficult to adequately prepare for exams, but his lectures were clear and informative. Attending lecture is important, but his class is definitely doable, and he typically curves the course at the end to account for difficult exams.

This is for 311. He definitely deserves 4 or 5 stars since he gave practice exams that were very very similar to the tests and he gave as many A's and B's as the department would allow him to. I wasn't a huge fan of how unnecessarily deep he would explain some topics, but it's hard to complain when he helps so much for tests.

Just reads off of notes. Bad handwriting. Quiet. Exams are worth 80%. Provides a cheat sheet at least but it doesn't matter much. You'll spend every second on the exams because of the enormous amount of work you have to write.

Please for the love of god do not take him for any course... Unless you want to teach yourself all of the course which is painful for something as abstract as linear algebra. 65% of the class was gone after the first few weeks, its clear he's very smart but he's quiet as a mouse and has horrible hand writing. The biggest bonus is he grades easy.
